column1: # BORU Language Specification: / modifiers on parens and dotted paths
# A `/` modifier on a parenthesised expression or a dotted path applies to
# the WHOLE group's result, not to the last key: `a.b/m` parses as
# `(a get b)/m`. The modifier qualifies how the result (a function value
# retrieved from the map) is treated/dispatched:
#   /u  usurp — call the function, reversing its signature arg order
#   /s  force the dispatch to STACK form
#   /f  force the dispatch to FORWARD form
#   /r  keep the function as DATA (do not invoke)
# §1  /u — usurp the function retrieved by a dotted path / paren
# §2  /f and /s — force the dispatch shape of the result function
# §3  /N — dispatch the result with exactly N args
# §4  /r and /q — keep the result as data (do not invoke)
# §5  no modifier — the grouped function auto-dispatches forward

column3: bare path: the function still auto-dispatches

column3: /q on a plain value is harmless
